dialogues.speaker: Kimpel
dialogues.text: How did Lumidouce Harbor end up like this... it's just terrible.

dialogues.speaker: Kimpel
dialogues.text: Look at all those ships down there. Do you think there are more vessels from Fontaine or other places?

dialogues.speaker: Kimpel
dialogues.text: Once, there were more Fontainian ships in the harbor. I don't know when it started, but at some point, there were more foreign ships instead.

dialogues.speaker: Kimpel
dialogues.text: If this continues, can this harbor still be considered Fontaine's harbor?

dialogues.speaker: Kimpel
dialogues.text: Goodbye. Hmm, how should I start this advisory letter...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Lumidouce Harbor isn't the only harbor in Fontaine...

dialogues.speaker: Kimpel
dialogues.text: I know, I know. But Lumidouce Harbor is an essential port. A vast quantity of international trade passes through here.

dialogues.speaker: Kimpel
dialogues.text: However, not even the big cargo ships have been coming through the harbor much lately...

dialogues.speaker: Kimpel
dialogues.text: I won't bother you with it now. I need to continue writing this advisory letter to Ms. Cassigneul. She should be able to turn things around here.
